test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the name of India’s first AI teacher introduced in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iris** is recognized as **India’s first Generative AI teacher**, introduced to revolutionize the classroom experience through humanoid robotics.
 
• It was officially unveiled in **March 2024** at the **KTCT Higher Secondary School** in **Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala**.
 
• The robot was developed by **Makerlabs Edutech**, a private firm based in **Kerala**, in collaboration with the **Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL)** project.
 
• **Iris** is designed to provide personalized learning experiences, capable of answering complex questions across various subjects and interacting with students in a human-like manner.
 
• The AI teacher is built on **Generative AI** technology, which allows it to process and generate content in real-time, supporting **three different languages** to cater to a diverse student base.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Physical Features and Mobility:**
 
 
• **Iris** has a **humanoid appearance**, specifically designed to look like a female teacher wearing a traditional **saree**.
 
• It is equipped with a **wheeled base** to facilitate movement within the classroom and features **hand gestures** to make the interaction more engaging for students.
 
• The robot uses a **voice assistant** and high-quality speakers to deliver lessons and respond to queries.
 
 
 
• **Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL) Initiative:**
 
 
• The **ATL** project is a flagship initiative of the **Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)** under **NITI Aayog**, **Government of India**.
 
• It aims to cultivate a spirit of curiosity, creativity, and imagination in young minds by providing access to **STEM** (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math) tools and **AI technologies**.
 
• The deployment of **Iris** highlights the success of these labs in encouraging homegrown technological solutions.
 
 
 
• **Role of Makerlabs Edutech:**
 
 
• **Makerlabs Edutech** is the technology partner responsible for the hardware and software development of **Iris**.
 
• The company focused on creating a **low-cost** yet highly capable **educational robot** that could eventually be scaled to other schools across **India**.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other AI Robots:**
 
 
• While **Sophia** (developed by **Hanson Robotics**) is famous as the world’s first robot citizen, **Iris** is specifically tailored for the **Indian educational curriculum** and classroom environment.
 
• Unlike standard chatbots, **Iris** combines **physical presence** with **AI logic**, which helps in maintaining student attention and fostering a better learning atmosphere.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Language Support:** **Iris** currently supports **English, Hindi, and Malayalam**, which are the primary languages of instruction in **Kerala**.
 
• **Technological Foundation:** The robot utilizes **Intel processors** and specialized **AI chips** to handle the heavy computational load required for **Generative AI** tasks.
 
• **Future Scope:** The introduction of **Iris** in **2024** marks a significant milestone in the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020** goals of integrating **AI** and coding into the school system.
 
• **Impact:** By acting as a 24/7 teaching assistant, **Iris** helps human teachers focus on **mentorship** while the AI handles factual queries and repetitive explanations.

1b
